race.comment: GYPSY RHYME (2) sets the standard after a first-up second at this track, beaten half a length as favourite, and her previous run was a CL3 win at Ascot when she beat Hedawood. Unbeaten second-up and she looks a progressive mare. Can go one better with the added fitness. SATIN BOW (10) is the clear danger, with a track-and-trip win two starts back and a closing fifth behind Annie Warbucks last start, though she has to turn around the recent line with GYPSY RHYME. ENCOSTA DE MONEY (3) can rebound from a wide, keen run when ninth over 1400m, especially back to a track-and-distance set-up where his record reads well. CATCH CARTER (1) drops out of a CL3 fourth at Ascot and was second at this venue the run before, giving him a solid form base despite the wide draw and 1200m record being more honest than dominant. FLAMING DRAGON (5) can bounce back dropping in distance.
